[SWS_CRYPT_20002]
⌈
The X.509 Provider shall store and provide the
root certificate and all needed CAs along the certification path, together with
the reference to the corresponding public and private keys, which are handled by the
Key Storage Provider. All elements, which are relevant for the certification
path, shall be stored with local access either hard-coded into the software or in a
persistent and tamper-proof manner. The decision how to store the elements is based
on:
• Updatability of certificates: When certificates shall be exchangeable or revocable,
then these are stored in a volatile but persistent storage. Fixed certificates, which
stay forever for example, can be stored hard-coded.
• Use case specific: An application or functional cluster can have pre-configured
certificates, which are stored along side the configuration, e.g. in ARXML.
• Project specific
⌋
